article_context: 围绕自动化可能带来的“无工作社会”展开，先呈现贫富分化和失去人生意义的悲观想象，再指出这些判断往往把当下以就业为中心的社会经验错误外推到未来。

article.title: 完型 · 无工作的未来一定会令人痛苦吗？
article.background: 围绕自动化可能带来的“无工作社会”展开，先呈现贫富分化和失去人生意义的悲观想象，再指出这些判断往往把当下以就业为中心的社会经验错误外推到未来。

sentences.en: People have speculated for centuries about a future without work.
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来，人们一直在设想一个无需工作的未来。

segments.text: People have speculated for centuries about a future without work.

sentences.en: Today is no different, with academics, writers, and activists once again warning that technology is replacing human workers.
sentences.zh: 今天也不例外，学者、作家和社会活动人士再次警告，技术正在取代人类劳动者。

segments.text: Today is no different, with academics, writers, and activists once again warning that technology is replacing human workers.

sentences.en: Some imagine that the coming work-free world will be defined by inequality: A few wealthy people will own all the capital, and the masses will struggle in an impoverished wasteland.
sentences.zh: 有人想象，未来的无工作世界将以不平等为特征：少数富人拥有全部资本，而广大民众则在贫困荒原中挣扎。

segments.text: Some imagine that the coming work-free world will be defined by inequality: A few wealthy people will own all the capital, and the masses will struggle in an impoverished wasteland.

sentences.en: A different and not mutually exclusive prediction holds that the future will be a wasteland of a different sort, one characterized by purposelessness: Without jobs to give their lives meaning, people will simply become lazy and depressed.
sentences.zh: 另一种并不与前者互斥的预测认为，未来会成为另一种荒原——一个以失去目标感为特征的世界：没有工作赋予生活意义，人们只会变得懒散而抑郁。

segments.text: A different and not mutually exclusive prediction holds that the future will be a wasteland of a different sort, one characterized by purposelessness: Without jobs to give their lives meaning, people will simply become lazy and depressed.

sentences.en: Indeed, today's unemployed don't seem to be having a great time.
sentences.zh: 的确，如今的失业者似乎过得并不愉快。

segments.text: Indeed, today's unemployed don't seem to be having a great time.

sentences.en: One Gallup poll found that 20 percent of Americans who have been unemployed for at least a year report having depression, double the rate for working Americans.
sentences.zh: 盖洛普的一项民调发现，失业至少一年的美国人中有20%报告自己患有抑郁症，这一比例是有工作的美国人的两倍。

segments.text: One Gallup poll found that 20 percent of Americans who have been unemployed for at least a year report having depression, double the rate for working Americans.

sentences.en: Also, some research suggests that the explanation for rising rates of mortality, mental-health problems, and addiction among poorly-educated, middle-aged people is a shortage of well-paid jobs.
sentences.zh: 此外，一些研究表明，受教育程度较低的中年人死亡率、心理健康问题和成瘾率上升，可能是因为缺少薪酬良好的工作。

segments.text: Also, some research suggests that the explanation for rising rates of mortality, mental-health problems, and addiction among poorly-educated, middle-aged people is a shortage of well-paid jobs.

sentences.en: Perhaps this is why many worry about the agonizing dullness of a jobless future.
sentences.zh: 也许正因如此，许多人担心无工作未来会陷入令人痛苦的乏味。

segments.text: Perhaps this is why many worry about the agonizing dullness of a jobless future.

sentences.en: But it doesn't necessarily follow from findings like these that a world without work would be filled with unease.
sentences.zh: 但这些发现并不必然意味着，一个没有工作的世界就会充满不安。

segments.text: But it doesn't necessarily follow from findings like these that a world without work would be filled with unease.

sentences.en: Such visions are based on the downsides of being unemployed in a society built on the concept of employment.
sentences.zh: 这类想象建立在这样一种经验之上：在一个以就业为核心构建的社会里，失业会带来种种弊端。

segments.text: Such visions are based on the downsides of being unemployed in a society built on the concept of employment.

sentences.en: In the absence of work, a society designed with other ends in mind could yield strikingly different circumstances for the future of labor and leisure.
sentences.zh: 如果工作不再存在，一个以其他目标为出发点设计的社会，可能会为未来的劳动与闲暇创造截然不同的环境。

segments.text: In the absence of work, a society designed with other ends in mind could yield strikingly different circumstances for the future of labor and leisure.

sentences.en: Today, the virtue of work may be a bit overblown.
sentences.zh: 今天，人们对工作之“美德”的赞扬也许有些言过其实。

segments.text: Today, the virtue of work may be a bit overblown.

sentences.en: "Many jobs are boring, degrading, unhealthy, and a waste of human potential," says John Danaher, a lecturer at the National University of Ireland in Galway.
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰国立大学戈尔韦分校讲师约翰·丹纳赫说：“许多工作既无聊、贬损人格，又有损健康，还是对人类潜能的浪费。”

segments.text: "Many jobs are boring, degrading, unhealthy, and a waste of human potential," says John Danaher, a lecturer at the National University of Ireland in Galway.

sentences.en: These days, because leisure time is relatively scarce for most workers, people use their free time to counterbalance the intellectual and emotional demands of their jobs.
sentences.zh: 如今，由于大多数劳动者的闲暇时间相对稀缺，人们会用有限的自由时间来抵消工作带来的智力和情绪消耗。

segments.text: These days, because leisure time is relatively scarce for most workers, people use their free time to counterbalance the intellectual and emotional demands of their jobs.

sentences.en: "When I come home from a hard day's work, I often feel tired," Danaher says, adding, "In a world in which I don't have to work, I might feel rather different" - perhaps different enough to throw himself into a hobby or a passion project with the intensity usually reserved for professional matters.
sentences.zh: 丹纳赫说：“辛苦工作一天回到家时，我常常觉得很累。”他还补充道：“在一个我不必工作的世界里，我的感受也许会大不相同。”——甚至可能不同到足以让他以通常投入职业事务的强度，投身于某项爱好或热爱的项目。

segments.text: "When I come home from a hard day's work, I often feel tired," Danaher says, adding, "In a world in which I don't have to work, I might feel rather different" - perhaps different enough to throw himself into a hobby or a passion project with the intensity usually reserved for professional matters.
